data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental in February 2032? You’re in for a treat: calm seas, fewer crowds, and crisp winter light over the Mediterranean. February sea temperatures average 15°C–17°C, with air temps 12°C–18°C and about 60 mm of rain over 6 days. With the right boat – heated cabin or covered flybridge – you can cruise comfortably from Puerto Banús to Cabopino or Estepona. Here’s exactly what to expect and how to choose your charter.

February Weather in Marbella: What to Expect

February is one of Marbella’s cooler months, but still mild compared to northern Europe. Average daytime highs reach 18°C, lows drop to 12°C. Sea temperatures sit at 15°C–17°C – too cool for a long swim without a wetsuit, but perfect for coastal cruising. Rainfall averages 60 mm, mostly in short showers. Wind is typically light (5–10 knots) from the west, making the bay inside Puerto Banús very sheltered.

Best Boats for a February Charter

For comfort in February, choose a boat with a heated cabin or enclosed flybridge. Our fleet offers several options:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – heated cabin, €749/2h or €2,299/8h.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – heated cabin, same pricing as Astondoa.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – enclosed flybridge with heating.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – covered saloon, €4,719/4h with free jet ski.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – spacious heated saloon, pricing on request.

All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. No hidden costs.

Top February Routes from Puerto Banús

Winter routes stay close to shore for shelter and scenic views. Here are three favourites:

  • Marbella to Cabopino (5 NM, 30 min) – pass the Golden Mile and Cabopino dunes. Calm waters, dolphin sightings common.
  • Marbella to Estepona (12 NM, 1 hour) – cruise west past San Pedro, stop for lunch at Estepona port. Sheltered all the way.
  • Coastal loop of La Concha (8 NM, 45 min) – view the iconic mountain from the sea, then return to Puerto Banús.

What to Wear and Pack for a February Boat Trip

Layers are key. Start with a base layer, add a fleece or jumper, and top with a windproof jacket. Bring a hat and sunglasses – the winter sun can still be bright. The boat’s cabin will be heated, so you can warm up between deck views. Don’t forget a camera for the low-angle winter light over the sea.

Why February Is a Smart Time to Rent a Boat

Fewer tourists mean more space and personalised service. You’ll have the bay almost to yourself. February also offers lower demand, so availability is better for larger groups. The sea is calm, and the risk of strong winds is minimal. Plus, you can enjoy a winter picnic on the water – our charters include cava, wine, and snacks.

Booking Tips for February 2032

Book 2–3 weeks ahead for weekends. Use WhatsApp for custom quotes on boats like the Canados 86 or Maiora 26m. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are fixed-price at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a jet ski. All prices include VAT. Cancellations are flexible with 48-hour notice.
